description: List scheduled and released macroeconomic events (e.g. CPI, non-farm payrolls, rate decisions) over a date range, each with its actual, previous, and consensus figures. Filter by country, impact level, issuing agency, or a specific recurring event_id. Defaults to the US and roughly the next 30 days.

agency.description: Issuing agency: BLS, BEA, Census, Fed, DOL, EIA.

event_id.description: Filter to a single recurring event, e.g. us_cpi.

from.description: Lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339. Default: now.

to.description: Upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339. Default: from + 30 days.

name: economic_calendar_list
title: Economic calendar
